<!-- nativecmpkit-progress:android-io-provider-lifecycle:41245152018:IO-021 -->
## Verified Android provider/lifecycle subset — issue remains open

[Run41245152018](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41245152018), attempt1 at `5585edac`: **5/5 actual API35 whole methods**, one original XML, Gradle **0/45.02s**, no skips/failure/error. This is one shared five-method batch, not five new methods for every issue.

### Accepted criteria subsets for this issue
- **Decoder failure closes source**: Actual production fetcher/Coil engine closes real transferred source after explicit injected decoder failure; no default bitmap decoder/EXIF/seek coverage. Methods: `nativeCoilDecoderFailureClosesCrossUidSourceAfterExactBinaryRead`.
- **Coil cancellation closes provider stream**: Actual coroutine cancellation closes real source under explicitly injected paused decoder; no every-stage or every-target inference. Methods: `nativeCoilCancellationClosesTransferredSourceWithoutLateSuccess`.
- **Binary content parity**: Full fixed binary payload equals actual Coil source bytes, with bookmark/survivor read parity supporting IO. Not all file types/targets/default bitmap decoding. Methods: `nativeCoilDecoderFailureClosesCrossUidSourceAfterExactBinaryRead`.

### Still required
- **Large image peak-memory benchmark by target**: No peak-memory, large-image or target-comparison benchmark.
- **Stable request key and modified-file invalidation policy**: Caches disabled for lifecycle checks; no stable request key or modified-file invalidation policy execution.
- **Main-thread misuse guidance test/sample**: Non-main Looper assertions show these source reads are correctly dispatched. They do not execute main-thread misuse guidance/test/sample.

1010 actual uploaded library maps and1087 frozen combined preflight match immutable Git; no uploaded actual combined map. Enforcing Android15/x86_64, installed helper APK bytes/signature/UID, genuine grants, strict API35-only signer scope and owned helper/graceful emulator/ADB cleanup are independently reviewed. Real fixed-tree/provider and **injected** Coil decoder checks do not substitute for Apple/system/cloud/default bitmap/EXIF/per-target peak memory or key-policy tests. Earlier null-size/provider-death cause remains unknown; accepted methods were not replayed.

[Source/results/integrity archive](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/540c1c1e13156a7233eee0e0f940cee12a36d6b4/docs/development/evidence/android-io-provider-lifecycle-20261031/native-ci001/README.md) · [Every original criterion](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/540c1c1e13156a7233eee0e0f940cee12a36d6b4/docs/development/evidence/android-io-provider-lifecycle-20261031/native-ci001/criterion-subset-review.json). The new three default-decoder methods are separately requested in [41249622333](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41249622333), **not accepted yet**. No whole-issue or release/security gate is cleared.
